name: reelstudio
description: Local reel factory: Codex is the producer and the crew; OpenRouter provides voice (TTS), images and word timestamps; Remotion + ffmpeg render the MP4 on your Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Topic in, vertical reel out: script, voice, images, frames check, MP4 render.
interface.longDescription: Codex writes the script, plans and codes the Remotion scenes and checks its own frames; the rs engine does voice (ElevenLabs via OpenRouter), images, word timestamps and the render, all in ~/ReelStudio.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30 second reel about why lists help your memory.
Show me my ReelStudio reels and brands.
Re-render my last reel with a new hook.
